questions: Are you having severe difficulty breathing right now?
Are you having chest pain, pressure, or tightness right now?
Have you fainted, become unusually difficult to wake, or felt close to fainting?
Have you suddenly developed weakness, numbness, facial drooping, trouble speaking, confusion, or loss of coordination?
Have you suddenly lost vision or developed a severe new headache?
Are you bleeding heavily or unable to stop bleeding?
Are you having severe or rapidly worsening pain anywhere?
Are you vomiting blood, passing black stools, or passing a large amount of blood?
Do you have a high fever with confusion, a stiff neck, or a widespread rash?
Do you have swelling of your face, lips, tongue, or throat, or rapidly worsening hives?
Are you having thoughts of harming yourself or someone else?
Have you been injured or had an accident recently?
Do you currently have any symptom or health concern that prompted this referral?
Did this problem begin suddenly?
Did this problem begin within the past 24 hours?
Has this problem been getting worse?
Have you had this problem before?
Do you have a fever?
Have you had chills or night sweats?
Do you have unusual tiredness or weakness?
Have you unintentionally lost weight?
Do you have a cough?
Are you coughing up blood?
Do you have palpitations or an irregular heartbeat?
Do you have swelling of your legs?
Do you have nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, or constipation?
Do you have abdominal pain?
Do you have pain or burning when urinating?
Have you noticed blood in your urine?
Are you pregnant or could you be pregnant?
Have you had unusual vaginal bleeding or discharge?
Do you have a new rash, sore, or skin discoloration?
Do you have new joint, muscle, or back pain?
Do you have numbness, tingling, tremor, or seizures?
Have you experienced new anxiety, depression, or major changes in sleep or behavior?
Do you have any diagnosed medical conditions?
Have you ever had heart disease, a stroke, diabetes, cancer, or a blood clot?
Have you had surgery or been hospitalized recently?
Do you take any prescription medications?
Do you take blood thinners, insulin, steroids, or hormone medications?
Do you have any medication, food, or environmental allergies?
Do you use tobacco, vaping products, alcohol, or recreational drugs?
Has anyone in your immediate family had early heart disease, stroke, cancer, or a hereditary illness?

Comprehensive neurological examination, including cranial nerves, visual fields, fundoscopy, strength, tone, reflexes, sensation, coordination, gait, and cognitive function
MRI of the brain with and without gadolinium contrast
MRI of the cervical and thoracic spine with and without gadolinium contrast
